verdict.rationale: Community comments confirm a free OneDrive tier exists (~20GB) and mention it works with the same clients/APIs described in the docs, but the evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of the exact quota or confirmation that free-tier accounts get the same API/client feature set as paid tiers. Missing for 10: official published free-tier storage quota page, explicit confirmation that Graph API and desktop/mobile clients behave identically on free accounts, and independent verification the free tier isn't artificially crippled.
